descriptionHtml:
Intel Core i5-14400F Desktop Tray Processor 10 Cores 16 Threads up to 4.70 GHz

Optimize your custom desktop building budget with the elite value of the Intel Core i5-14400F Tray edition processor. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance PC hardware core component layout is shipped in standard tray packaging without a retail box or stock cooler, making it the absolute ideal choice for tech-savvy gamers, e-commerce web builders, and system integrators across Egypt who intend to deploy superior aftermarket air or liquid cooling thermal solutions. Built on Intel's refined 14th Gen Raptor Lake Refresh architecture, this CPU delivers high-tier computational execution and modern multi-app multitasking stability.

The Intel Core i5-14400F Tray version provides an advanced hybrid architecture layout combining 6 Performance-cores and 4 Efficient-cores to deliver 10 total physical cores and 16 heavy processing threads. Operating at a 2.50 GHz base frequency that reaches a maximum turbo translation of 4.70 GHz via Intel Turbo Boost 2.0, it processes intensive gaming engines effortlessly. Backed by 20MB of responsive Intel Smart Cache, this platform provides dual-channel tracking matrix options for both high-capacity DDR4 3200MHz and next-generation DDR5 4800MHz desktop memory setups. Utilizing secure PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 data channels directly through the LGA1700 motherboard socket, this 'F' suffix variant features a 65W base power standard and strictly requires a discrete independent graphics card to handle display outputs. (Please Note: This is a Tray processor model; a separate aftermarket thermal cooling solution must be sourced for operational deployment).
